title: Operator ceremony: rebuild cam-worker image (post-CAM-179) and verify zero blocking prompts in interactive docker exec worker
description: After CAM-179 merges, rebuild the cam-worker image to bake the new claude-config.json, then run an interactive docker exec -it cam-worker ... claude --permission-mode bypassPermissions --agent <agent> with cwd /workspace and confirm zero blocking prompts (no first-run onboarding/theme picker and no /workspace trust-this-folder dialog). This is the live proof-of-fix for CAM-179 before re-running the full CAM-175 end-to-end ceremony.
